code.extract_of: airq_tick.py run with AIRQ_WINDOW=2026: the constants and metrics, meets, corrected, ab_ok, haversine and outcome as written, stage A over the kept AQS files and stage E as written. airq_promote.py and airq_tie.py, which run after it, leave these fields as they are

name: AIRQ
sources: EPA Air Quality System hourly PM2.5 (parameter 88101), https://aqs.epa.gov/data/api/sampleData/byState for each state, 1 March to 30 June 2026, read month by month. data/w2026/aqs_NN.json keeps the daily means the read built from those rows.

PurpleAir outdoor sensors within 200 metres of each monitor, https://api.purpleair.com/v1/sensors (data/w2026/pa_near.json), and each sensor's daily history, https://api.purpleair.com/v1/sensors/ID/history with average=1440 (data/w2026/pa_ID.json, the answer as served, with its time_stamp). A PurpleAir read needs a PurpleAir key.
why_not_included: PurpleAir terms allow its data and anything derived from it only for internal testing and bar passing it on
